title: CONNECT-UDP Tunnel Setup Policy Verification
verification_method: Focused unit tests, SpecTrace JSON validation, generated coverage triage, and diff hygiene for RFC 9298 tunnel setup policy.
scope: This verification covers target extraction from reconstructed headers, percent-decoded target host and port, endpoint selection for UDP socket opening, response-before-target-packet policy, DNS-before-reply gating, setup error rejection, Proxy-Status failure details, and client abort on non-success responses.
preconditions: RFC 9298 URI Template, target validation, HTTP/3 request policy, and vulnerable-target filtering helpers are trace-owned.
expected_result: The focused tunnel setup policy tests pass, core SpecTrace validation accepts the RFC 9298 tunnel setup artifacts, generated triage reflects the slice as trace-clean, and diff hygiene passes.
status_summary: The RFC 9298 tunnel setup policy surface is trace-owned and verified by focused local gates. Live UDP socket lifecycle and forwarding remain future adapter work.
